_설명: 사연드라마 쇼츠 벤치 다섯 채널(10-13) 편별 상대 관계·결말 갈래·돈/재산 축. state title(제목)·script(받아쓴 대본, 없으면 빈칸). 거르기.py --spec 으로. 숫자 들어간 제목·조회수 배수는 코드로.

counterpart.instructions: This is a Korean first-person life-story short (사연). Who is the main other person the narrator deals with (the one who wrongs, worries or surprises the narrator)? Use `title`, and `script` if it is not empty.

criteria.시댁·처가·사돈: An in-law: mother-in-law, daughter-in-law, son-in-law, father-in-law, the other set of parents (사돈), sister-in-law

자식·손주.what: The narrator's own son, daughter or grandchild
자식·손주.not_for: a son-in-law or daughter-in-law (that is 시댁·처가·사돈)

criteria.부모: The narrator's own father, mother or stepparent
criteria.부부: The narrator's husband or wife (or ex-spouse)
criteria.형제·친척: The narrator's brother, sister or other relatives
criteria.이웃·동네: A neighbor, people in the village or apartment, the person next door
criteria.직장·일터: A boss, employer, coworker, client at work, a day-labor employer
criteria.가게·손님: A shop or restaurant owner and a customer, a regular customer, a landlord-tenant in a store
criteria.처음 보는 사람: A stranger, a public official, a passenger, someone met by chance
criteria.해당 없음: None of these, or it is not a story

ending.instructions: How does this story pay off at the end?

criteria.사이다: Someone who ignored, cheated or bullied the narrator gets what they deserve through proof or a calm counterattack; no hidden kindness is revealed
criteria.반전감동: A person the narrator suspected, resented or misunderstood turns out to have a hidden good reason or secret kindness; no one is punished
criteria.둘 다: Both happen in the same story: a wrongdoer is punished AND someone's hidden kindness is revealed
criteria.해당 없음: Neither, or cannot tell from the text

is_property.instructions: The story revolves around land, a house, an apartment, an inheritance, a will, or a large sum of family money.

is_family.instructions: The main conflict or secret is between family members (parents, children, spouses, in-laws, siblings, grandchildren).
